description: Bill Ackman is a hedge fund manager and the founder and CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management, which has a fund listed on Euronext Amsterdam.
Jeff Bezos is an entrepreneur who founded Amazon, serves as its executive chairman, owns Blue Origin and The Washington Post, and is co-CEO of Project Prometheus.
Vinod Khosla is a venture capitalist and founder of Khosla Ventures, and a co-founder of Sun Microsystems.
Satya Nadella is the Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Microsoft, which he has led as CEO since February 2014.

Eliezer Yudkowsky founded the Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI) and LessWrong, co-authored the best-selling book 'If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies' (Little, Brown, 2025), and was named to the TIME100 AI 2023 list.

Steven Pinker is listed by Harvard as the Johnstone Family Professor of Psychology, and he is the author of widely read books including The Language Instinct, The Better Angels of Our Nature and Enlightenment Now.
Tyler Cowen is an economist, author and commentator who holds the Holbert L. Harris Chair of Economics at George Mason University and co-founded the Marginal Revolution blog.
Nassim Nicholas Taleb is an author and risk researcher, known for the five-volume Incerto series, which includes Fooled by Randomness.
Nate Silver is an election forecaster and writer who founded FiveThirtyEight and now publishes the Silver Bulletin newsletter.
Bill Gates is a co-founder of Microsoft, chair of the Gates Foundation, and author of the Gates Notes blog.
Nouriel Roubini is an author and Project Syndicate columnist who is Chairman and CEO of Roubini Macro Associates and Professor Emeritus at NYU Stern, widely known as 'Dr. Doom'.
Michael Burry is a widely known investor who founded Scion Capital/Scion Asset Management and writes a paid Substack newsletter, reported by Yahoo Finance to have passed 300,000 subscribers.
Ray Dalio founded Bridgewater Associates in 1975 and was its CEO until 2017, and is the author of several books including Principles: Life and Work.
Jim Cramer is a financial television host and commentator who has hosted CNBC's "Mad Money" since 2005, co-anchors "Squawk on the Street," founded TheStreet and has written several published books.
Rodney Brooks is a roboticist, MIT professor emeritus, and co-founder of iRobot, Rethink Robotics and Robust.AI.
Balaji S. Srinivasan is a technology entrepreneur, investor and author who was formerly CTO of Coinbase and a general partner at Andreessen Horowitz, and who founded Network School.
Marc Andreessen co-created the Mosaic browser, cofounded Netscape, and is cofounder and general partner of the venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz.

Gary Marcus is an author and AI entrepreneur and professor emeritus at NYU; he has written six books, including Rebooting AI and Taming Silicon Valley, founded Geometric Intelligence (bought by Uber), testified at the May 2023 US Senate AI hearing, and writes a newsletter with over 121,000 subscribers.

Yann LeCun is a computer scientist who shared the 2018 ACM Turing Award, is a Jacob T. Schwartz Professor at NYU's Courant Institute, was Meta's Chief AI Scientist and founding director of FAIR, and is Executive Chairman of AMI Labs.
Elon Musk is a business executive who is CEO of Tesla and CEO and Chief Engineer of SpaceX, and who owns X.

Sir Demis Hassabis founded DeepMind, leads Isomorphic Labs, shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and was knighted for services to AI; he was DeepMind's CEO until August 2026, after which he was reported as chairman of Google DeepMind and chief scientist of Alphabet.
Dario Amodei is co-founder and CEO of Anthropic and a former VP of Research at OpenAI, where he led work on GPT-2 and GPT-3.
Scott Alexander is a writer known for his blogs Astral Codex Ten and Slate Star Codex and for fiction including Unsong.
Warren Buffett led Berkshire Hathaway as chairman from 1970 and as CEO until January 1, 2026, and now serves as chairman emeritus and a board member.
Sam Altman co-founded OpenAI and serves as its chief executive officer, according to OpenAI's own announcement and Crunchbase.
Daniela Amodei is listed as co-founder and President of Anthropic on the company's leadership page and in her Wikipedia article.
Mark Zuckerberg is a technology entrepreneur who co-founded Facebook and serves as founder, chairman and chief executive officer of Meta Platforms.
Jeremy Grantham is an investor who co-founded the asset managers GMO and Batterymarch, is listed by GMO as its long-term investment strategist, and co-authored 'The Making of a Permabear'.

Ray Kurzweil is an author of books on artificial intelligence and the technological singularity, including The Singularity Is Near, The Singularity Is Nearer, The Age of Spiritual Machines and How to Create a Mind; he received the 1999 National Medal of Technology and Innovation, became Director of Engineering at Google and co-founded Singularity University.
Jensen Huang is the co-founder, president and chief executive officer of NVIDIA, and a member of its board of directors.
Peter Thiel is an entrepreneur and venture capitalist who co-founded PayPal and Palantir Technologies and founded Founders Fund.
GiveWell is a US-based nonprofit charity evaluator that researches and recommends high-impact giving opportunities, mainly in global health and poverty reduction.
Ørsted is a Danish energy company, formerly DONG Energy, that develops, builds and operates offshore wind farms and other renewable energy assets.
